topics.definition: A computer network is a collection of interconnected devices that communicate and share resources.
tips: Networks enable communication and resource sharing.

topics.definition: Computer networks evolved from small local systems to the global Internet.
tips: The Internet is the world's largest network.

topics.definition: Common types are PAN, LAN, MAN and WAN.
topics.example: Wi-Fi at home is a LAN
tips: Choose the type based on coverage area.

topics.definition: Topology describes how devices are connected.
Devices such as routers, switches, hubs, bridges and modems enable communication.
tips: Each device has a specific function.

topics.definition: Data is transmitted using wired or wireless media.
tips: Fiber provides high speed and long distance.

topics.definition: Performance is measured using bandwidth, latency, throughput and packet loss.
Networks support communication, file sharing, cloud computing and online services.
tips: Networks are essential in modern computing.

topics.definition: Secure, monitor and maintain networks for reliable operation.
